QuestInfo.name: Cold Desert Nights 1
QuestInfo.0: Jiyur coughs do not seem to cease. It's strange that someone would get a cold in a hot place like Ariant. Go speak with Jiyur.
QuestInfo.1: Jiyur said the temperature in the desert was extreme, making it easy to catch a cold. He needed #r#t4000930##k, #r#t4000931##k, and #r#t4000932##k items to make cold medicine. Alpha and Beta set out to help.
QuestInfo.2: You got the ingredients to make the cold medicine for Jiyur. You are concerned since eating medicine does not keep a person from catching a cold.

0.0: *cough, cough* Stay back! I don't want to get you sick! *cough, cough* It gets so c-c-cold at night in the desert!
0.1: If my sister were here, she'd bring me some Cold Medicine... Could you get me some please?

yes.0: I could really use some #r#t4000930##k items for my sore throat, some #r#t4000931##k items for my fever, and some #r#t4000932##k items for my runny nose. I think #r8 of each#k would be enough for my medicine.

no.0: ...My cold is just getting worse and worse... Cough, cough, cough, cough, cough...

1.0: Did you bring the Cold Medicine?

yes.0: This Cold Medicine will help me heal quick. Thank you so much.

default.0: Do you have the #r#t4000930##k, #r#t4000931##k, and #r#t4000932##k items yet? I feel really sick. *cough, cough*
